description: How long to roast beef, lamb, pork, chicken or gammon by weight, with the oven temperature, resting time, the temperature to take it out at and a tip. Beef can be rare, medium or well done; lamb pink or well done; lamb and pork shoulder are slow roasted; gammon can be roasted or simmered. Give a serving time to get when it goes in.

cut.description: Optional. beef: joint. lamb: leg or shoulder. pork: loin, shoulder or belly. chicken: whole. gammon: oven or boil.

doneness.description: Optional. beef: rare, medium or well. lamb: pink or well.

serve_time.description: Optional serving time as HH:MM in 24-hour time, e.g. 14:00. When given, the answer says when it goes in the oven.

weight.description: Weight of the meat, in the unit given by unit.

name: roast_cooking_time
title: Roast cooking time
